rule: Element names, container IDs, parameter counts and six sub-parameter names are source-derived. AI/ASI/shared classification is an additive Phase-2 mapping and does not rewrite source records.

elements.name: State and Signal Intake
elements.reason: Acquires and normalizes state/evidence before interpretation; governance applies to authority and source boundaries but the local function is cognition/runtime intake.

elements.name: Pattern and Context Integration
elements.reason: Combines signals, context, engines and source evidence into a working representation while preserving contradiction.

elements.name: Prediction and Counterfactual Simulation
elements.reason: Projects candidate trajectories and counterfactuals; simulation is not promoted to source fact.

elements.name: Decision and Priority Arbitration
elements.reason: AI can compare and score alternatives; authority, priority, rule conflict and permission belong to ASI governance.

elements.name: Action and Execution Control
elements.reason: Execution/tool control is an AI/runtime function, but legal action requires ASI authority, permission, barrier and rollback constraints.

elements.name: Verification and Uncertainty Control
elements.reason: AI executes tests/calibration and contradiction detection; ASI governs truth/provenance, proof debt, acceptance and closure implications.

elements.name: Memory and Learning Integration
elements.reason: AI retrieves/compresses/adapts; ASI governs write-back, version, contamination, durability and evolution authority.

elements.name: Governance, Safety and Recovery
elements.reason: Permissions, safety boundaries, rollback, self-healing, authority and termination are meta-governance responsibilities; AI mechanisms may detect/execute but do not own final authority.

source_activation_contract.activation_trigger: Relevant task signal + segment routing + minimum one authorized source or explicit synthetic-fuel label
source_activation_contract.required_inputs: Point Zero; current state; linked engine outputs; source lineage; goal and constraints
source_activation_contract.suppression_conditions: No authority; unresolved safety boundary; contradictory state without checkpoint; termination signal
source_activation_contract.mandatory_pairing: Reality Anchor for simulation; Evidence Ledger for claims; External Checkpoint for high-impact action
source_activation_contract.termination_condition: Goal satisfied, proof debt bounded, action handed off, or Critical Logic Wall stops continuation
source_activation_contract.memory_write_condition: Validated outcome with source and engine lineage; rejected alternatives retained
